title: union/1: the feature tables of several series joined into one target list
description: The answer of `mzlab-cli quant union --json` and of the `lr_union` route (same bytes in the site and the app): `csv` is the table `quant targets --targets` reads (id, mz, rt_min, rt_max, polarity, role), `targets` the same rows with the rows each came from. Rows of different series are one target when their m/z agree within `da` and their RT, after the optional `rt_warp` map onto the first series, within `rt_tol`; rows of one series are never merged (two targets that stay within both tolerances are listed in `conflicts`, both kept). Nothing is refused for a finding; every automatic choice is in `choices`. Code: crates/mzlab-core/src/series_union/.

da.description: m/z agreement of two rows of one target, Da.

rt_tol.description: RT agreement after the map, min.

rt_gap.description: Widest RT gap of an anchor pair of the map, min.

pad.description: Minutes added on both sides of every window.

polarity.description: Polarity given to the rows that have none of their own; empty: every scan.

merged.description: Targets that hold rows of more than one series.

joined.description: Rows that joined a target of an earlier series.

anchors.description: Rows both this series and the first one hold (piecewise only).

applied.description: False when fewer than 3 anchors left the series as it is.

id.description: U0001, U0002, ... sorted by polarity (none, -, +), m/z, RT.

rt.description: Mean RT of the rows in the frame of the first series, min.

rt_min.description: Start of the window: the earliest start of a row's own window, less `pad`, at least 0.

series.description: Number of series that hold the target.

members.description: The rows the target came from: the first is the one the others were compared with.

line.description: Line in the table, the header is line 1.

rt.description: RT in the table of its own series.

rt_warped.description: RT after the map, in the frame of the first series.

delta_mz.description: m/z minus that of the first row.

delta_rt.description: rt_warped minus that of the first row.

conflicts.description: Targets of one polarity within `da` and `rt_tol` that could not merge (rows of one series); both are in `targets`.

dropped.description: Targets left out because fewer series than `min_series` hold them.

choices.description: Every automatic choice: rt_warp (anchors, max_shift), rt_warp_skipped (anchors), window_from_rt_tol (rows without a window got rt +- rt_tol), polarity_from_param (rows), rt_min_clamped (targets whose start fell below 0).

csv.description: id,mz,rt_min,rt_max,polarity,role, one row per target, role `target`.
